title: Templates
toc: false
tbl-colwidths: [34, 50, 16]
template-questions:
  spc: How does the probability of recall vary with study position?
  pnr: Which study positions supply the first, second, or later response?
  termination_probability: How likely is recall to end at each output position?
  crp: How likely is a transition at each forward or backward lag, given the items still available?
  lagrank: How near are successive recalls in study position compared with the available alternatives?
  distcrp: How does transition probability vary with the distance between items?
  distrank: How close is the next recalled item compared with the other items still available?
  cat_recall_rate: What proportion of the studied items in each category are recalled?
  cat_spc: How does recall vary with study position within each category?
  catcrp: Given the items still available, how likely is the next recall to come from the same category?
  fitting: Which parameter values best fit the observed recalls?
  simulation: What recall sequences does a fitted model predict for the studied lists?
  parameter_shifting: How do predictions change when you vary a fitted parameter?
  model_comparison: How do models fitted to the same pooled data compare on likelihood, AIC, and recall behavior?
---
